title: Extend ONNX Frontend with `Shape-15` operator
body:
## Context
Neural networks are graphs consisting of nodes called operators. Each operator corresponds to a mathematical function, usually described in framework's documentation or an AI standard, such as ONNX.

OpenVINO ONNX Frontend is a component responsible for working with ONNX graphs and requires implementation of different ONNX operators in order to use ONNX models.

This task requires extending OpenVINO ONNX Frontend with `Shape-15` ([ONNX Shape](https://onnx.ai/onnx/operators/onnx__Shape.html#l-onnx-doc-shape) operator since ONNX Opset 15). 
ONNX Shape operator has been extended with additional "start, end" attributes, what should be reflected in the conversion logic.
Currently those attributes are ignored by ONNX FE, and ONNX Shape is converted directly to [`ov::ShapeOf`](https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/blob/master/docs/ops/shape/ShapeOf_3.md),
but it can be supported at the ONNX FE conversion step, with additional [`ov::Slice`](https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/blob/master/docs/ops/movement/Slice_8.md) layer.

Necessary help will be provided by ONNX Fronted team.


## Operator specification
Operator details can be found in [ONNX Operators](https://github.com/onnx/onnx/blob/main/docs/Operators.md).


## Todo list
1. Update `.hpp` and `.cpp` files: 
[/openvino/src/frontends/onnx/frontend/src/op/shape.hpp](https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/blob/a6e5f6bdb45897758cd720489de29350d415f1bd/src/frontends/onnx/frontend/src/op/shape.hpp)
[/openvino/src/frontends/onnx/frontend/src/op/shape.cpp](https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/blob/a6e5f6bdb45897758cd720489de29350d415f1bd/src/frontends/onnx/frontend/src/op/shape.cpp)
2. Prepare an implementation of this operator in form of a function. It should be placed in [set_15 namespace](https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/blob/a6e5f6bdb45897758cd720489de29350d415f1bd/src/frontends/onnx/frontend/src/op/shape.hpp#L16).
3. Register the next version of the Shape operator: `REGISTER_OPERATOR("Shape", 15, shape);` in [ops_bridge.cpp](https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/blob/a6e5f6bdb45897758cd720489de29350d415f1bd/src/frontends/onnx/frontend/src/ops_bridge.cpp#L474) while keeping alphabetical order
4. Create ONNX Shape-15 test model(s) in [ONNX models directory](https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/tree/master/src/frontends/onnx/tests/models/). OpenVINO test infrastructure then converts prototxt files to ONNX models - you will use those models later in tests. Double check the ONNX opset version of the model that should be at least 15.
5. Add tests covering all use cases [here](https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/blob/master/src/frontends/onnx/tests/onnx_import.in.cpp)

More details in [adding operators to ONNX Frontend guide](https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/blob/master/src/frontends/onnx/docs/how_to_add_op.md)

## Resources
- [Contribution guide - start here!](https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- Guides on [ONNX Frontend architecture](https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/blob/master/src/frontends/onnx/docs/architecture.md) and [ONNX Frontend tests](https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/blob/master/src/frontends/onnx/docs/tests.md)


## Example PRs
- https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/pull/15076
- https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/pull/14936
- https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/pull/12510

## Tips
Proper implementation should enable the following tests:
https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/blob/a6e5f6bdb45897758cd720489de29350d415f1bd/src/frontends/onnx/tests/__init__.py#L138
https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/blob/a6e5f6bdb45897758cd720489de29350d415f1bd/src/frontends/onnx/tests/tests_python/test_backend.py#L322-L329
Also for compatibility API: https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/blob/a6e5f6bdb45897758cd720489de29350d415f1bd/src/bindings/python/tests_compatibility/test_onnx/test_backend.py#L330

Don't hesitate to reach out, we're here to help!

comments.body:
Hello @participant3, thank you for taking this issue, the idea is explained in the [issue description above](https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/issues/20194#issue-1921961998):

> This task requires extending OpenVINO ONNX Frontend with Shape-15 ([ONNX Shape](https://onnx.ai/onnx/operators/onnx__Shape.html#l-onnx-doc-shape) operator since ONNX Opset 15).
> ONNX Shape operator has been extended with additional "start, end" attributes, what should be reflected in the conversion logic.
> Currently those attributes are ignored by ONNX FE, and ONNX Shape is converted directly to [ov::ShapeOf](https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/blob/master/docs/ops/shape/ShapeOf_3.md),
> but it can be supported at the ONNX FE conversion step, with additional [ov::Slice](https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/blob/master/docs/ops/movement/Slice_8.md) layer.

In other words, the goal is to add support for the `start` and `end` attributes of the ONNX Shape-15, by conversion to `Slice(ShapeOf(data), start, end, 1, 0)` subgraph.
Also please take a look at the TODO steps and example PRs, where related files are mentioned.
